ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Science, ICT and Future Planning and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Ordinance No. 1, March 24, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through <18> Omitted.

<19> The Rules on International Money Orders shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 4, Article 5 (1), and the former part of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 6, respectively, "Minister of Knowledge Economy" shall be replaced with "Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning."

<20> through <31> Omitted.
